dimensions.name: Acceptance criteria
dimensions.evidence: The implemented read-only inventory, source separation, scoped joins, unknown/stale handling, authority checks, cancellation, and browser clearing conform to the approved Plan. Actual acting-user administration-read acceptance and stacked #50/#52 prerequisites remain open; the selected-host receipt is operator evidence, not user acceptance.

dimensions.name: Implementation completeness
dimensions.evidence: Tasks 1.2, 2.1–2.2, 3.1–3.2, and 4.1–4.2 are implemented. Task 1.1 exhaustive-bound/unsupported-layout evidence is explicitly pending; hosted verification and integration tasks 4.3–4.4 remain open.

dimensions.name: Tests
dimensions.evidence: The supplied local verification report records 54 Node, 154 web, 38 runtime, and 41 browser tests passing. Inspected tests exercise exact committed reads, dirty worktrees, redaction, no-follow/replacement defenses, authority, cancellation, concurrency, browser clearing, and narrow/keyboard behavior. Exhaustive at/over-limit and unsupported-layout audit for Task 1.1 remains pending.

dimensions.name: Quality checks
dimensions.evidence: Full local verification is reported passing; hosted CI is pending.

dimensions.name: Security
dimensions.evidence: No concrete code/security finding identified in the reviewed implementation. Host reads use pinned no-follow descriptors and isolated committed Git objects; process cancellation/cleanup, global nonqueueing caps, current-user/App/repository authority conjunction, immediate scoped clearing, and source redaction are implemented. No runtime control, operator-token fallback, capacity/process-health inference, or source writes were found.

dimensions.name: Architecture / design conformance
dimensions.evidence: The implementation follows the approved bounded, read-only helper, owner-session lifecycle, independent GitHub authority, source-specific observations, and explicitly unsupported-layout choices.

dimensions.name: Documentation
dimensions.evidence: README, runtime runbook, architecture documentation, and the runtime view describe configuration, bounds, read-only behavior, unknown semantics, and release limitations consistently with the reviewed code.

dimensions.name: Product / spec consistency
dimensions.evidence: The accepted Plan and implementation preserve the first-slice scope and product independence: they do not claim process health, capacity, usage, scheduling, reservations, or production readiness. The owner-approved planning decision is not reopened.

dimensions.name: Evidence
dimensions.evidence: Exact-head local verification and an actual selected-host operator observation receipt are present. Hosted CI, final Task 1.1 bound audit, stacked prerequisites, and actual acting-user administration-read acceptance remain pending. The host receipt is not user-App acceptance.

dimensions.name: Human review
dimensions.evidence: This is the independent code-checkpoint audit and supports a reversible DEVELOPMENT preview only. Final Done review, protected approvals, integration, and production/product gates remain open.

dimensions.name: Known limitations
dimensions.evidence: The Plan, runbook, and receipts explicitly retain the pending CI, prerequisite, acting-user, physical-device, and final-audit limitations, and do not present this checkpoint as full Done or issue closure.
